_schemaNote: Stage-A capture (gate epic toon-protocol/toon-meta#210 ladder, entered via toon-protocol/toon-meta#257). Mirrors the org convention from relay#77 / store#59 / toon#120 et al: flat top-level `correctness`/`speed`/`performance`/`regressionTolerancePercent` keys are the machine-read contract for the LATER freeze+guard slice (stage B) — nothing consumes them yet in this repo; this file only captures what exists. The richer sections layered on top are the human-readable capture.

capturedFrom.note: toon-protocol/buzz is a fork of block/buzz. At capture time the fork has ZERO Actions run history of its own (gh run list is empty) — every CI number below is therefore either measured locally against this commit or sampled from the latest green upstream block/buzz main run, and is labeled as such. The capture working tree also contained the docs-only commit d0a4391 (PR #8, CONTEXT.md + 3 ADRs — no code/CI-affecting paths), which does not affect any measured number.

method: correctness: each gate command was run locally against main@4d47aa8 with the repo's
hermit-pinned toolchain (node 24.15.0, pnpm 11.4.0, just 1.46.0) and rust 1.95.0
(rust-toolchain.toml). Rust compile-level checks (clippy, test-unit) were run inside the
.sandcastle agent image (the host lacked pkg-config/libssl-dev; the image is the
environment the factory gate actually runs in, so it is the representative measurement).
speed: local wall-clock of the same runs. Rust numbers are COLD-compile (fresh target/
in the sandbox); warm iteration is far cheaper.
performance: fork has no Actions history, so runner-minutes are sampled from upstream
block/buzz main run 30680360633 (2026-08-01, green) as a like-for-like proxy —
same workflows, same commit lineage, GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest.

gateShape.taskRunner: just (Justfile is the single de-facto gate driver; ci.yml calls just targets)

workspaces.rust: 26-member cargo workspace under crates/ + examples/countdown-bot (desktop/src-tauri is EXCLUDED from the workspace)

commands.rustTest: just test-unit  (cargo nextest: buzz-core/buzz-auth --lib, buzz-cli, buzz-db --lib, buzz-conformance, buzz-push-gateway — the infra-free unit set)
commands.desktopLint: just desktop-check  (biome check + file-size + px-text + pubkey-truncation guards)
commands.desktopBuild: just desktop-build  (tsc && vite build — doubles as the desktop typecheck)
commands.webLint: just web-check  (biome check + file-size + pubkey-truncation guards)
commands.webBuild: just web-build  (tsc && vite build — doubles as the web typecheck)

gateShape.ciWiring: Upstream ci.yml gates via paths-filter: rust-lint (fmt-check + desktop-tauri-fmt-check + clippy), unit-tests (test-unit via nextest 0.9.136 + mold), desktop-core (desktop-check/test/build + tauri clippy/check/test), web (web-check + web-build), mobile (dart format + flutter analyze/test + android build), security (cargo-deny), desktop smoke/integration e2e (Playwright, sharded), backend-integration + relay-e2e (Postgres/Redis), server-cross-compile (musl x2), windows-rust, desktop-build-macos. The agent-gate subset above is the infra-free intersection an agent sandbox can honestly run.

gateCorrectness.description: Violation counts against a clean checkout of main@4d47aa8. buzz enters the ladder with ZERO measured debt on every check in the agent gate — there is nothing to freeze; stage B can guard at zero.

clippy.note: PASS measured inside the sandcastle:buzz agent image (exit 0, -D warnings); see gateSpeed for cold-compile cost

rustUnit.note: PASS inside the agent image via cargo-nextest 0.9.136 (exit 0; final suite 15 passed / 6 skipped — skips are the #[ignore]d Postgres-backed set, by design)

gateSpeed.description: Local capture environment: WSL2, cold Rust target/ inside the agent image for clippy/test-unit; hermit toolchain on the host for the JS side. No fork CI history exists to sample.

local.note: clippy/test-unit measured INSIDE the sandcastle:buzz agent image against a bind-mounted worktree with a cold target/ (real 3m21.6s / 2m0.6s; ~5x core parallelism). gateWallClockSeconds (395) = fmt + tauri-fmt + clippy-cold + test-unit + pnpm install + JS-side checks run sequentially — the honest worst-case first-iteration cost of the full agent gate; warm iterations are far cheaper.

upstreamCiSample.note: block/buzz main run 30680360633 (green, 2026-08-01), Swatinem/rust-cache warm — the realistic CI-side cost of the same checks

gatePerformance.description: toon-protocol/buzz is PUBLIC — GitHub-hosted Actions minutes are unmetered. No fork runs exist yet, so runnerMinutes stays null until the first representative run of the agent gate on this fork; the guard slice (stage B) treats null as record-only.

dockerImageSize.note: `docker images` reports 3.97GB after the first local build; node:24-bookworm + the rustup 1.95.0 default-profile toolchain dominates. Roughly 2x the org's pnpm-only images (~2.07GB).

outOfScope.description: Explicitly NOT part of the factory agent gate (no silent rubber stamps — these are excluded by design and still covered by upstream ci.yml on every PR):
items: Flutter/mobile (mobile/**): flutter 3.41.7 + Android SDK not in the agent image; the mobile CI job and mobile-release-candidate pipeline stay upstream-only.

desktop/src-tauri compile-level checks (desktop-tauri-clippy/check/test): excluded from the cargo workspace; need GTK/WebKit system libraries + generated sidecar stubs. Only its rustfmt check (just desktop-tauri-fmt-check) is in the agent gate.
Playwright e2e (desktop smoke/integration, web e2e, relay e2e): browser + docker-compose service dependencies.
Postgres/Redis-backed integration tests (just test-integration, backend-integration job): live infra.
cargo-deny (security job): stays in upstream CI; not re-run per agent iteration.
server-cross-compile, windows-rust, desktop-build-macos, signing/canary/release/helm workflows: platform/secret-bound, untouched by the factory (KEEP rule).

admin-web: pre-existing gap — upstream ci.yml has NO admin-web job (its check/test scripts exist but nothing gates them); the agent gate mirrors CI and does not add it. Candidate for a later ratchet slice.

environment.ciRunner: ubuntu-latest (GitHub-hosted; fork is public — minutes unmetered)
